title: Portrait and Witness
author: August Vane
blurb: Tamsin Nystrom, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
